description: Search Sentry issues (grouped errors, crashes, and user feedback) and list them with status, occurrences, users impacted, assignee, and first and last seen. Accepts natural language or Sentry issue search syntax. For individual events, counts, or aggregates, use search_errors, search_logs, or search_traces.

includeExplanation.description: Return how the query was translated or repaired.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

period.description: Only issues with activity in this window.

projectSlugOrId.description: The project slug or numeric ID.

query.description: Natural language or Sentry issue search syntax, e.g. `is:unresolved level:error firstSeen:-24h assigned:me release:latest environment:production issue.priority:high issue.category:feedback userCount:>100`.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

sort.description: date: last seen; freq: event count; new: first seen; user: user count; recommended: Sentry's priority ranking.

name: search_issues

reporter.description: Who submitted a feedback issue. Null for other issues.

title: Search Issues
